overview: Slow start, congestion avoidance (AIMD), ssthresh, timeout/duplicate ACK behaviour, cwnd evolution.
coreConcept: Slow start me cwnd exponentially, avoidance me linearly; loss par ssthresh = cwnd/2.
hinglishExplanation: Slow start me har RTT cwnd double. ssthresh tak pahunchne ke baad har RTT +1 MSS. Timeout par cwnd = 1 MSS aur ssthresh = cwnd/2. Effective window = min(cwnd, receiver window).
formalDefinition: Slow start me cwnd exponentially, avoidance me linearly; loss par ssthresh = cwnd/2.
importantProperties: Slow start: cwnd doubles per RTT.
commonPitfalls: Slow start ko linear maan lena.
